name: import_asset_from_url
title: import_asset_from_url
description: Downloads a file from a URL into the project and imports it. Free. This is the escape hatch that makes the asset pipeline work with services this plugin has never heard of: call whatever API you like yourself, then hand the resulting URL here and let the plugin handle writing it into res:// and getting Godot to import it. Works for meshes, textures and audio. Asynchronous; the imported path arrives as an 'asset_ready' event.

name.description: Filename stem. Defaults to the URL's filename.

cleanup.description: Flag the result as wanting a cleanup_mesh pass.

errors.already_running: An asset job is in flight.
errors.download_failed: The URL could not be fetched.
